title: BIPA 2 celebrate 1 League 2024/25 title
description: BIPA 2 celebrated 1 League 2024/25 title in Ukraine. In the Final game they edged Khmelnytskyi 64-54. Trailing 13 points at the halftime, BIPA replied with a massive 17-1 surge in the third quarter and closed the campaign with a final 21-14 run. Naemtsu top-scored for the winners with 24 points and Igor Solovey (G-2002) posted 18. Maxim Gulya (190-G-2004) replied with 15 points in the losing effort.
